entities.name: PTH_1024
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt A5D3F8 from Pelotomaculum thermopropionicum; annotated as a probable transcriptional regulatory protein.
Reference annotations indicate cytoplasmic localization, DNA binding, and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.
Sequence contains Pfam TACO1_YebC_N (residues 5–76) and Transcrip_reg (residues 82–239) domains.
